svg.title: DistilBertForQuestionAnswering: one Linear(768, 2) turns every token vector into a start and an end score
svg.text: qa_outputs = Linear(768, 2): rows S and E, 1,538 parameters
keep only spans with both ends in the context
i ≤ j < i + 40, then answer = context[offset(i).start : offset(j).end]
the BERT page derives S and E; here they are simply the two output rows of the head
